feishu.title: Feishu / Lark
feishu.description: Connect local lark-cli so AI can work with documents and Base records.
feishu.binaryHelp: Leave blank to detect automatically, or enter an absolute path to the native executable.
feishu.profileHelp: Leave blank for the CLI default profile. Verification and operations use this same setting.
feishu.permissionsHelp: Account verification confirms login only. Access to documents and tables is checked during each operation.
feishu.externalSetup: Install, configure and log in to lark-cli separately. The CLI manages credentials.
feishu.accessHelp: Feishu and note permissions are separate and share this connection's dedicated MCP credential.
feishu.state.not_installed: CLI not found. Install it or enter its native executable path.
feishu.state.incompatible: Required CLI interfaces are missing. Update the CLI externally.
feishu.state.not_logged_in: No CLI user login. Log in externally.
feishu.state.login_expired: CLI user login expired. Log in again externally.
feishu.state.network_error: Could not reach Feishu. Check the network and retry.
feishu.state.invalid_configuration: Invalid CLI path or configuration. Check settings.
feishu.state.invalid_cli_response: Unrecognized CLI response. Check its version.
feishu.state.cli_failed: CLI verification failed. Check configuration and login externally.
feishu.state.permission_denied: CLI permission denied. Check authorization externally.
feishu.state.confirmation_required: CLI confirmation required. Complete setup externally.
feishu.state.output_limit: CLI output exceeded the limit. Verification stopped.
feishu.state.invalid_request: CLI rejected verification. Check the version and profile.
update.title: App updates
update.search: Check for updates, current version, latest version, download and install
update.development: Development mode only checks versions. Update the source and restart Dev.
update.windowsHelp: After verification, the app quits and opens the installer.
update.macHelp: After verification, the app quits and opens the DMG. Drag the new version to Applications.
update.installing: Quitting the app and opening the installer…
update.error.connection: Cannot read update status. Reopen Settings and retry.
update.error.network: The update request failed. Check your connection and retry.
update.error.storage: Cannot save the installer. Check disk space and folder write permissions, then retry.
update.error.rate: The update service is rate limited. Try again later.
update.error.release: Cannot read a stable release. Check again later.
update.error.platform: This system or architecture is not supported by this update.
update.error.asset: The latest release has no installer for this system yet. Check again later.
update.error.checksum: Installer verification failed or checksum information is missing. Installation was not started. Check again or download again.
update.error.check: Check for updates before downloading and installing.
update.error.install: Cannot open the installer. Download it again and retry.
mcp.connectionDescription: Manage note, Feishu and connection permissions for local AI clients and ChatGPT.
mcp.title: MCP access permissions
mcp.scope: Note access covers all connected Markdown, TXT and HTML; Feishu access is controlled separately. RAG uses selected folders only.
mcp.localRead: Allow local AI to read all notes
mcp.localReadHelp: Enabling generates a dedicated connection configuration. Older configurations retain their original reading scope.
mcp.localWrite: Allow local AI to modify notes
mcp.writeHelp: Changes save directly with history; deleted notes go to Trash. Off by default.
mcp.tokenOnce: This configuration contains a private credential shown only now. Save it in your AI client. Regenerating immediately revokes the old credential.
mcp.copyFailed: Copy failed. Copy the configuration above manually.
mcp.tunnelRead: Allow ChatGPT to read all notes
mcp.tunnelReadHelp: Uses the ChatGPT connection below. Permission changes reconnect automatically; refresh the tool list in your client.
mcp.legacy: Connections without full access retain the five original read-only capabilities. Disable access at any time to revoke dedicated credentials.

tunnel.title: ChatGPT connection
tunnel.description: Use OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel to query your local knowledge in ChatGPT on the web.
tunnel.desktopOnly: Configure this connection in the LeafLoom desktop app.
tunnel.keyHelp: Use a runtime key with Tunnels Read + Use. It is encrypted by the system. Leave blank to keep the saved key.
tunnel.keyPlaceholder: Enter your OpenAI Tunnel runtime key
tunnel.auto: Enable and connect when the app starts
tunnel.lifecycle: Closing the window keeps the connection running. Quitting stops it. Disconnecting also disables automatic connection.
tunnel.statusHelp: Channel ready means the local service and Tunnel are prepared. Add the plugin in ChatGPT the first time.
tunnel.unsaved: Connection changes are not saved. Use the save button above.
tunnel.setup: When the channel is ready, add a custom MCP in ChatGPT: choose Tunnel, use the same Tunnel ID, select No authentication, then install and select it in a chat.
tunnel.privacy: ChatGPT receives the knowledge returned by each tool call. Associate the Tunnel only with accounts or workspaces you trust. Stop any manually started client to avoid duplicate runtimes.
tunnel.search: ChatGPT, Tunnel ID, App Key, credentials, connection
tunnel.error.config: Invalid Tunnel ID or configuration. Check the settings and reconnect.
tunnel.error.key: The runtime key is missing or was rejected. Check your App Key.

tunnel.error.binary: The bundled Tunnel runtime is missing. Reinstall LeafLoom with Tunnel support.

tunnel.error.storage: Unable to read or save connection settings. Check permissions on the app state directory.
tunnel.error.process: The Tunnel runtime is not running correctly. Reconnect or open the logs.
tunnel.error.network: OpenAI Tunnel is temporarily unreachable. Retrying automatically; check your network or proxy.

macOS 14/15 的 Safari 需要本机解析配置。仅配置本应用的专属域: Safari on macOS 14/15 requires local resolver setup. Only this app’s domain is configured; macOS requests administrator authorization.
不改变默认 DNS；移除后仍可使用 App 和其他兼容浏览器。: Default DNS stays unchanged. The app and other compatible browsers remain available after removal.
本机解析服务尚未运行，请重新启动本地服务后重试: The local resolver is not running. Restart the local service and retry.
配置 Safari 本机网页兼容: Setting up Safari local website compatibility
将当前画板的图层位置、缩放、旋转和文案修改保存到 Design/layer-tr: Save layer position, scale, rotation, and text changes of the current artboard to Design/layer-transforms.json.
将当前选中的画板图层作为上下文引用添加到 AI 对话: Add the currently selected artboard layer as a context reference to AI chat.
已将选中图层添加到 AI 对话: Added selected layer to AI chat.
在知识库目录中浏览该项目的所有 Markdown 与设计文件: Browse all Markdown and design files of this project in the knowledge folder.
在浏览器独立标签页中打开: Open in a standalone browser tab
在知识库中开启类 Figma 网页与 UI 设计: Start Figma-like Web & UI Design in Your Knowledge Folder
选择知识库中的任意目录创建设计项目。每个项目包含多画板、可拖拽/缩放/旋转的图层: Choose any folder in your knowledge vault to create a design project. Each project includes multi-screen artboards, a draggable/resizable/rotatable layer tree, component contracts, and asset manifests, with direct AI/MCP collaboration.
在知识库中新建设计项目: New design project in knowledge folder
选择知识库内的目标文件夹，LeafLoom 将在该位置生成符合 1.1.0 规范: Choose a target folder inside the knowledge vault. LeafLoom will scaffold a 1.1.0-compliant design project there (including multi-artboards, layer editing engine, project spec, and Wiki index).
请输入或选择知识库内的项目目录路径: Enter or choose a project folder path inside the knowledge folder.
请输入画板名称或标识: Enter an artboard name or ID.
请选择或输入知识库内的项目子目录名称: Choose or enter a project subdirectory name inside the knowledge folder.
画板宽高须在 120 到 7680 像素之间: Artboard width and height must be between 120 and 7680 pixels.
site.title: LeafLoom — Your local knowledge base & personal wiki
site.description: A local-first, open-source home for your Markdown, HTML and ideas. Connect your notes with a knowledge graph and optional AI. Download for Windows and Mac.
site.eyebrow: OPEN SOURCE · LOCAL FIRST · YOURS TO KEEP
site.headline: A home for everything you know.
site.intro: Turn notes, project docs and saved webpages into a connected knowledge base and personal wiki. Keep your files local. Bring AI in when you want it.
site.hero_note: Free to use · No signup · English / 中文 / 日本語
site.demo_caption: The real app, with a fictional demo library. Screenshots follow your language.
site.markdown_alt: A Markdown note in LeafLoom with a table, tasks, outline and backlinks
site.features_intro: A quiet place to think, and a clear path back to the ideas that matter.
site.markdown_title: Make room for your next idea.
site.markdown_body: Write on the formatted Markdown page. Add tables and tasks with slash commands, paste images or drop attachments. Switch to source with shared undo history.
site.graph_body: Link notes in both directions and explore them in a knowledge graph. Follow a concept to a reading note, then back to the project it inspired.
site.graph_alt: Connected demo notes in the LeafLoom knowledge graph
site.html_title: A home for saved webpages, too.
site.html_body: Open local HTML projects alongside your notes, with their styles, images and supported scripts. Keep your reading material close to your own thinking.
site.html_alt: A local HTML reading room open inside LeafLoom
site.search_title: Find the source. Keep the context.
site.search_body: Start with keyword search and Wiki navigation. Prepare the optional local semantic-search model when you need it. Follow results back to their original notes.
site.search_alt: LeafLoom search results linking back to original notes
site.local_eyebrow: LOCAL BY DESIGN. CONNECTED BY CHOICE.
site.local_title: Your files. Your knowledge. Your call.
site.files_body: Notes and indexes live on your computer. Read, edit, explore and search locally, without a hosted knowledge base.
site.scope_body: No folders are indexed by default. Browse first, then explicitly choose what to search. Browsing and retrieval have separate scopes.
site.optional_title: Bring AI in on your terms
site.optional_body: AI Chat sends enabled context to your chosen provider; ChatGPT receives requested tool results. External AI connections are optional.
site.ai_eyebrow: WHEN YOU WANT AI, YOUR KNOWLEDGE IS READY
site.ai_title: Give your AI something worth knowing.
site.ai_body: Chat beside your notes, follow citations and review suggestions. Connect your assistant through MCP and the bundled Skill, or use the built-in Tunnel to bring your knowledge into ChatGPT.
site.ai_alt: AI Chat beside a LeafLoom note, with a clearly labeled fictional conversation
site.ai_caption: Fictional AI conversation; no external AI was called. ChatGPT needs an account, network access and the relevant permissions, with LeafLoom running.
site.download_eyebrow: START WITH A FOLDER OF YOUR OWN
site.download_intro: Install the desktop app. Try the demo or open your own folder. No preinstalled Python, Node or Ollama needed.
site.install_note: Current installers are unsigned; the Mac app is not notarized. See the installation guide for system prompts. No Linux, Intel Mac or Windows ARM installer is provided.
site.faq_question: Can I use LeafLoom without AI?
site.faq_answer: Yes. Reading, editing, the graph and keyword search work without a model, and work offline after dependencies are prepared. Prepare BGE-M3 only for local semantic search. External AI and ChatGPT need their own accounts, permissions and network access.
site.footer_line: Keep your knowledge local. Let your ideas grow.
feishu.highRiskHelp: Includes CLI high-risk commands and raw API calls. Requires write access; each operation still needs explicit confirmation.
site.about_intro: I’m the creator of LeafLoom. Find my projects and updates on GitHub and X.
site.about_github: Explore my open-source projects and code.
site.about_x: Follow my posts and latest updates.
主组件必须保留一个根元素，请在根容器内插入内容: A main component must keep one root element. Insert content inside its root container.
仍在使用的素材会保留；历史引用的原始文件可恢复: Assets in use are protected. Originals referenced by history remain recoverable.
从素材到可交互的游戏画面，人工与 AI 一起设计。: Design interactive game screens with your assets, by hand and with AI.
使用 design_document 和 design_operations 读: Read with design_document and edit with design_operations. Include the current revision and a unique operation ID; each request is one undo step.
例如：萌宠安家 或 cozy-ui: For example: Pet Home or cozy-ui
修改已保留，保存尚未完成: Changes are retained; saving is incomplete
历史跨页面保存；关闭重开后仍可撤销和重做: History spans pages and remains available after reopening.
原项目保持完整；在新目录转换页面、图层和素材。: Convert pages, layers and assets into a new directory while preserving the original project.
发布组件后，可在其他项目中选择版本使用: Publish components to use selected versions in other projects.
在最新版本应用待保存修改: Apply pending changes to latest revision
待上传文件无法恢复，请重新导入: Pending upload could not be restored. Import the file again.
待保存记录损坏，已保留原始记录: Pending records are damaged; the originals have been retained.
拖入或粘贴图片，再点击素材插入: Drop or paste images, then click an asset to insert it.
描述该画板的核心组件与交互目标: Describe this artboard's key components and interaction goals
无法保留待保存修改，请检查浏览器存储空间: Could not retain pending changes. Check browser storage space.
源码修改仍保留在草稿中: Source changes remain in the draft.
源码草稿无法保存到浏览器，请及时应用修改: Could not save the source draft in the browser. Apply your changes soon.
点击画布中的元素调整外观，双击文字直接编辑。拖动调整位置，按住 Shift 多选: Click an element to adjust its appearance; double-click text to edit. Drag to move, and hold Shift to select multiple elements.
用 mount(ctx) 添加交互和动画，返回清理函数。代码与参数都可以撤销。: Add interactions and animation with mount(ctx), returning a cleanup function. Code and parameters support undo.
素材尚未使用，主组件中的引用也受到删除保护: No page references. References in main components are also protected from deletion.
编辑时动画暂停；停止试播会恢复设计状态: Animations pause while editing. Stopping preview restores the design state.
脚本参数必须是 JSON 对象: Script parameters must be JSON objects.
请先退出主组件编辑，再执行此操作: Exit main component editing before this action.
请先选择同一容器中的元素: Select elements in the same container first.
转换完成，原项目保持完整: Conversion complete. The original project is preserved.
选择元素后创建主组件，跨页面重复使用: Select an element to create a reusable main component.
选择素材替换当前图片: Choose an asset to replace the current image.
预览运行在项目隔离环境中。请用返回的清理函数释放事件和资源。: Preview runs in the project's isolated environment. Return a cleanup function to release events and resources.
此旧页面只有元数据，原项目没有对应画面；已保留为空白页面: This legacy page had metadata but no rendered content; it is preserved as a blank page.
项目有待保存或损坏的修改记录，请先打开项目处理后再移动、复制或删除: This project has pending or damaged change records. Open it and resolve them before moving, copying or deleting it.
当前知识库有待保存或损坏的设计修改，请先打开对应项目处理后再撤销或重做项目管理操: This knowledge base has pending or damaged design changes. Open the affected project and resolve them before undoing or redoing project management actions.
项目已移动；部分源码草稿仍保留在原目录，请撤销移动后处理草稿: Project moved. Some source drafts remain under the old directory; undo the move to resolve those drafts.
当前后台尚未加载项目管理功能，请从托盘退出并重新启动应用；仅刷新页面无效。: The running service has not loaded project management. Quit the app from the tray or menu bar and reopen it; refreshing the page is not enough.
项目管理尚未就绪，请稍后重试: Project management is not ready. Please retry shortly.
